messages:
Alana (Design): Quick microcopy review — empty state for the Active Sessions list + the small tooltip for the Restore action. Current draft feels wordy. Need 1) empty state line, 2) tooltip text (max ~60 chars), and 3) copy for the confirmation when restoring an old session. Can we do quick takes?

Sophie (Content): I can take a pass. Context: users can create sessions to keep model context and reuse. Empty state should be helpful + invite action. Tooltip should be super short.

Mike (Product): Agree. Also want to avoid implying persistence guarantees. Maybe include a subtle hint about retention policy somewhere else, not the tooltip.

Alana (Design): Current copy draft: 

Full empty state: `No active sessions yet. Sessions hold model context (temperature, history) so you can resume interactions later.`
Tooltip draft: `Restore this session to rehydrate context.`
Restore confirm: `This session is older than 24 hours. Restoring may not reproduce previous results exactly. Continue?`

Sophie (Content): My edits — three compact options: 
A) Empty: `No sessions yet — create one to keep context.`
B) Empty: `No active sessions. Create a session to save context and history.`
C) Empty: `No sessions. Start one to preserve chat history and settings.`

Tooltip options (pick one): 
1) `Restore session`
2) `Restore saved context`
3) `Rehydrate session`

Confirm dialog options: 
- `This session is older than 24 hours. Restoring may not match previous outputs. Proceed?`
- `Restore anyway` (confirm CTA) / `Cancel` (secondary)

Mike (Product): I like B for clarity but shorten to avoid wrapping on small screens. For tooltip, prefer `Restore session` (1). For confirm, shorten: `Session older than 24h. Restoring may change outputs. Continue?`

Raj (Eng): UI note — tooltip area clamps at ~60 chars, so `Restore session` is perfect. Confirm modal has room, but we should avoid technical terms like `rehydrate` in user-facing text. Also: we show timestamps in the modal header so we don't need `older than 24 hours` in the body if header already shows date.

Aria Bot: Accessibility check: tooltip must not duplicate the visible button label exactly — include a brief purpose, e.g., `Restore session (loads saved chat state)` as aria-label. Ensure confirm dialog buttons have clear accessible names and focus trap.

Alana (Design): Updated combined draft after suggestions: 

Empty state (final candidate): `No active sessions. Create a session to save chat history and settings.`
Tooltip (final candidate): `Restore session` (aria-label: `Restore session — loads saved chat state`).
Confirm dialog body: `This session is from a previous time. Restoring may produce different outputs. Continue?`
Confirm CTA: `Restore session` / Secondary: `Cancel`

Sophie (Content): Tiny tweak: change `produce different outputs` -> `produce different results` (so it's less technical).

Mike (Product): +1 on Sophie tweak. Also request we add an inline link in the empty state to docs: `Create a session to save chat history and settings. Learn more.` (docs link as inline CTA).

Raj (Eng): Implementation: tooltip text `Restore session` and set `aria-label` to full phrase. For the confirm, we can pull timestamp into subtitle and keep body as Sophie/Mike's suggested sentence. I'll cap tooltip at 40 chars in code to be safe.

Alana (Design): Great — final copy agreed: 
- Empty: `No active sessions. Create a session to save chat history and settings. Learn more.`
- Tooltip: `Restore session` (aria-label: `Restore session — loads saved chat state` )
- Confirm body: `This session is from a previous time. Restoring may produce different results. Continue?`
- Confirm CTA: `Restore session` / `Cancel`

Alana (Design): Can someone from Eng and Content drop the final strings into the components repo and mark for localization? Tagging @Raj and @Sophie. Also will add this to the agenda for Thursday's design sync. :sparkles:
